description: This file defines the interface 'MeetingWritePlatformService' which declares methods for handling meeting-related operations such as create, update, delete, and attendance updates in a meeting scheduling system.

classes.name: MeetingWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface specifying the contract for meeting management operations, including creation, updating, deletion, and attendance handling.

methods.name: createMeeting
methods.description: Creates a new meeting based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateCollectionSheetAttendance
methods.description: Updates attendance records for a collection sheet, based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: updateMeeting
methods.description: Updates an existing meeting based on the provided JSON command.

methods.name: deleteMeeting
methods.description: Deletes a meeting identified by the given meeting ID.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateAttendance
methods.description: Saves or updates attendance information based on the provided JSON command.
